name: How to Ensure Your Easy Grip Cabinet Pulls Are Installed Perfectly

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Getting your easy grip cabinet pulls installed just right can really elevate your kitchen or bathroom. Here's a quick guide to make sure you nail it every time. First off, mark your placement carefully. A good tip is to use masking tape on the cabinet surface where the pull will go. This not only protects the finish but also gives you a clean surface to mark your measurements. Second, measure, measure, measure! Before you drill, confirm the center-to-center spacing of your new pulls and compare it to your existing holes, if any. If you're starting fresh, test out the placement with some removable adhesive or tape to make sure it feels right and looks good. Third, drill pilot holes. This is crucial to prevent splintering. Always drill from the outside face of the cabinet door or drawer and make sure you're drilling straight and perpendicular to the surface. Fourth, fasten by hand. Once your pilot holes are drilled, use a screwdriver to hand-tighten the screws. Avoid power tools, as they can easily overtighten and strip threads or crack the wood. Finally, test for wobble and alignment. Before fully tightening, make sure the pull feels secure and is perfectly level. If you're tackling a whole kitchen, a rigid template or jig can be a lifesaver for consistent results.
